implementation_ontology.actual_algorithm: Nodal stress/hourglass force assembly, hexahedral geometry/strain, monotonic artificial viscosity and ideal-gas EOS
implementation_ontology.mapping_covariates: All3 framework_device_kernel with15 authored entry definitions/model and own indices/allocation/launch. Shared62k-character mathematical helper, ABI-independent array offsets, host time integration, fixtures and scientific audit authored in reference phase then reused KA/JACC. CUDAjl staticlaunch; KA own kernel/index/backend; JACC public LaunchSpec256threads and explicitshmem0 prescribed before check to match zero algorithmic shared memory. Source kernels have private local8/24/32-element arrays, no inter-thread barrier/atomic primitive on scoped positive-volume path. Actual register/spill/occupancy/traffic/FLOP counts unprofiled; private-array representation/indexing/dispatch are covariates, no causal bottleneck or roofline claim.
implementation_ontology.precision_scope: FP64 device geometry/forces/EOS/transcendentals and Int32 indices/connectivity/flags. Julia source-AST helper retains source expression/cast/order and row-major private arrays through StaticArrays.MVector and inline typed array offsets. Full Float64 artifact losslessly encodes actual Int32 values and FP64 storage. Every typed guard, initial actual source input/metadata/region and readonly array checked exact. General1e-7+3e-8relative fixed before GPU; independent geometry/physical relations and analytic controls checked separately. Maximum native-versusJulia absolute full-state difference2.9802322387695312e-8; maxrelative5.45697e-5 arises near zero, not uniform relative accuracy.
implementation_ontology.support_boundary: Seven cases: source Sedov nx1/3/7/30 with1/4/4/3cycles respectively, plus nx3 single-cycle uniform rest, isotropic affine expansion/compression controls (zero initial internal energy and alpha0/+.01/-.01, dt1e-4). Original full30cubed mesh27000elements/29791nodes, actual11region initializer/cost1/balance1 retained. One-element source naturally reaches stop time in first cycle; no artificial cycles after stop. All cases source256threads/ceil launch geometry, positive volumes and no invalid-volume error path. Early-cycle state fidelity is not complete Sedov solution, grid convergence, shock-position or total-energy conservation certification.
